name: looping dot menu

files.index.html: Standalone current human test, seven real named links and accessible trigger.
files.menu.css: Transparent three-row mobile window,56px targets,12px same-size solid/hollow trigger; original vertical desktop layout.
files.menu.js: createLoopMenu(root), returning destroy(); pointer/wheel/keyboard controller with responsive and reduced-motion lifecycle.
files.motion.js: Pure infinite cyclic position, exponential flick decay and velocity-continuous critically damped alignment.
files.requirements.json: Requested behavior, integration decisions and verification limits.
files.landscape-validation.json: Twelve evaluated media-query scenarios, synchronized CSS/JS/no-script rule, verification limits.
files.trigger-slide.js: Closed-trigger flick switch after12px inward intent, including curved paths and final pointerup sampling; open lock and cancellation preserved.
files.trigger-slide.test.mjs: node --test trigger-slide.test.mjs;22 gesture and edge-case regression tests.
files.handedness-validation.json: Gesture and desktop fixed-scroll verification, geometry and limitations.
files.flick-fade-validation.json: Flick root causes, replacement gesture contract, reveal timing and validation.

integration: Load menu.css, use .loop-nav/.loop-toggle/.loop-panel/.loop-link markup from index.html, and load menu.js as a module. No external JavaScript, fonts or image dependencies. Seven existing source-site hrefs retained; replace with project destinations when supplied.
mobile: Narrow viewports <=767px, or hover:none + pointer:coarse + height<=600px: retain the mobile looping menu, including landscape phones wider than767px. Large fine-pointer desktops retain vertical navigation. Geometry/gestures unchanged. Closed trigger can be dragged to either edge; menu mirrors to opposite side. Open trigger stays locked. Chosen side remains for the current page session. A12px inward flick sends the trigger to the other edge; crossing the middle or maintaining speed is unnecessary. Opening fades the entire menu over360ms.
desktop: Seven source-style dots remain position:fixed at left30px/top50px while the document scrolls; verified with 757px body scrolling and exact unchanged dot bounds.
motion: Drag follows pointer, release decelerates into aligned row. Wheel/trackpad deltas are smoothed and gently aligned without injecting a second inertial tail. New input interrupts motion immediately; wrapping occurs outside clipped window.
accessibility: Native links/button/region; only centered link in tab order; ArrowUp/Down cycle following visual direction; Home/End; Enter; Escape returns focus to trigger. Resizing moves focus out of newly hidden content. Reduced-motion avoids coast and alignment animation. Pinch zoom allowed in touch region. While closed, focus trigger and use ArrowLeft/Right to choose handedness; hidden help documents the gesture. Trigger settling respects reduced motion.
